name: Why Can't I Hold All These Limes
aka: Why Can't I Hold All These
look: A photo of a store advertisement: a man with a shaved head, in a white polo shirt, grins as he clutches an armful of limes to his chest while more limes tumble down, his other hand raised. Shirts hang at both edges.
use: Someone has more of something than they can handle, often by their own choice. The usual caption reads "why can't I hold all these" plus the thing, with the limes standing in for too many tabs, projects, pets or problems.
slots: the setup, often "why can't I hold all these" (top)
what he has too much of (bottom)
examples: Why can't I hold all these
Why can't I hold all these
describe: man dropping a bunch of limes and laughing
guy in a white polo juggling too many limes
dude struggling to carry an armful of green fruit
bald man holding limes that are falling everywhere
too many limes falling out of his arms
origin: A snapshot of a store advertisement poster in which a model fumbles an armful of limes.
